family_meta.description: BirdNET+ V3.0 global wildlife classifier (11,725 classes: 11,709 species, birds and other fauna, and 16 non-animal sound classes; scientific and common names).
family_meta.author: Cornell Lab of Ornithology & Chemnitz University of Technology

3.0.description: BirdNET+ V3.0 global wildlife classifier (11,725 classes: 11,709 species, birds and other fauna, and 16 non-animal sound classes; scientific and common names).

requirements_note: requirements.min_ram_mb is a conservative, high-biased RAM floor: measured peak RSS + 15% where a benchmark exists, else a size-derived estimate biased high (a too-low floor risks OOM; a too-high floor only over-excludes on the smallest devices). Measured values will replace the estimates over time.
selection_notes: Regional models are the low-RAM choice: a region slice is numerically identical to the global model on the species it keeps and needs less memory than it; each entry's requirements.min_ram_mb gives its floor (measured on RPi5: 214 MB peak RSS for nordic, 470 MB for the global model). This release ships FP32 only, so every backend selects FP32. OpenVINO runs at f32 only and is not recommended: its margin over ONNX Runtime CPU was 7% at most where it was measured.

birdnet-plus-v3.0-b1.changes: GPU-native export of the BirdNET+ V3.0 release checkpoint (EfficientNetV2-S backbone, 11,725 classes: 11,709 species and 16 non-animal sound classes) from upstream model-converter tag v1.0.0 (commit 85e80e5): the in-graph STFT replaced with an equivalent Conv1d framing+DFT, predictions output dimension pinned to the class count; fp32 only, the fp16 files are not published (they score wrong on the Cortex-A76); 43 regional slices on the Perch v2 region tiles, selected with the Geomodel v3.0.2 range filter and a reviewed rename table, each also containing Homo sapiens and the 16 sound classes. 5 s @ 32 kHz window.

openvino-cpu.note: run at f32 only: the default f16 hint gives wrong scores on the Cortex-A76 and Intel GPUs; on the Raspberry Pi 5 it is no faster than ONNX Runtime and needs about twice the memory

openvino-gpu.note: run at f32 only: the default f16 hint gives wrong scores on Intel GPUs; 98 ms against 105 ms for ONNX Runtime CPU on an Intel Iris Plus Graphics 640 (nordic tile)

graph.notes: in-graph ONNX STFT replaced by an equivalent Conv1d; every op has a CUDA/OpenVINO kernel
